result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.set_edge_attrs_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Set attributes on all selected edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7371-L7439){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.set_edge_attrs_ws(**attributes) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Updates or adds attributes to edges in the current selection. The `weight` attribute receives special handling as it's a first-class edge property. Requires an active edge selection. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [**attributes]{.doc-parameter-name} : Attribute name-value pairs to set on selected edges. Use `weight` to update edge weights directly. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#f84d9d9a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_path_graph(3) # Select and update edge attributes edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() ( graph .select_edges_by_id([edge_ids[0]]) .set_edge_attrs_ws(weight=5.0, type='strong') ) # Check updated attributes edge = graph.get_edge(edge_ids[0]) # Returns 5.0 edge.weight ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 5.0 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#fa819abd .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 'strong' edge.attributes['type'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 'strong' ``` ::: ::: Bulk weight updates: ::: {#ab2a3c88 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(3) # Set all edge weights to 1.0 ( graph .select_edges(lambda e: True) # Select all edges .set_edge_attrs_ws(weight=1.0) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : False Density : 0.67 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
